title: Khara's army marches to Rama
introduction: Khara, the brother of Shuurpanakha starts out to wage war with Rama with fourteen thousand demons and with their unusual arsenal. This is the first major move of demons towards Rama that leads to the ultimate battle at the end of epic.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये किष्किन्ध काण्डे द्वा विंशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 22nd chapter in Aranya Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
एवम् आधर्षितः शूरः शूर्पणख्या खरः ततः |
उवाच रक्षसाम् मध्ये खरः खरतरम् वचः
verses.iast:
evam ādharṣitaḥ śūraḥ śūrpaṇakhyā kharaḥ tataḥ |
uvāca rakṣasām madhye kharaḥ kharataram vacaḥ
verses.translation: Thus when Shuurpanakha disparaged that valiant Khara amidst demons he is infuriated and spoke these highly hurtful words.

verses.devanagari:
तव अपमान प्रभवः क्रोधो अयम् अतुलो मम |
न शक्यते धारयितुम् लवण अंभ इव उल्बणम्
verses.iast:
tava apamāna prabhavaḥ krodho ayam atulo mama |
na śakyate dhārayitum lavaṇa ambha iva ulbaṇam
verses.translation: "This fury of mine originating from the disgrace brought on you is like the highly bitter salt water that is impossible to contain when ingested.

verses.devanagari:
न रामम् गणये वीर्यान् मानुषम् क्षीण जीवितम् |
आत्म दुश्चरितैः प्राणान् हतो यो अद्य विमोक्ष्यति
verses.iast:
na rāmam gaṇaye vīryān mānuṣam kṣīṇa jīvitam |
ātma duścaritaiḥ prāṇān hato yo adya vimokṣyati
verses.translation: "I do not care the valour of that Rama for he is a human with dwindled lifetime, now going to give up his life slain by his own misdoings.

glosses.meaning: human, one with dwindled, lifetime, Rama will be
by [his] valour, not, I do not reckon - I do not care
now, lives, is going to give up.

verses.devanagari:
बाष्पः संधार्यताम् एष संभ्रमः च विमुच्यताम् |
अहम् रामम् सह भ्रात्रा नयामि यम सादनम्
verses.iast:
bāṣpaḥ saṃdhāryatām eṣa sambhramaḥ ca vimucyatām |
aham rāmam saha bhrātrā nayāmi yama sādanam
verses.translation: "Control your tears and cast off your despair too, for I will send Rama to the abode of the Terminator along with his brother.

verses.devanagari:
परश्वध हतस्य अद्य मन्द प्राणस्य भू तले |
रामस्य रुधिरम् रक्तम् उष्णम् पास्यसि राक्षसि
verses.iast:
paraśvadha hatasya adya manda prāṇasya bhū tale |
rāmasya rudhiram rak{}tam uṣṇam pāsyasi rākṣasi
verses.translation: "Now, you demoness, you will swill that Rama's red hot blood when that short-lived one is hewed down to earth with an axe." So Khara assured Shuurpanakha.

glosses.meaning: one who is with slowed down, lives - short-lived Rama

verses.devanagari:
सा प्रहृष्ट्वा वचः श्रुत्वा खरस्य वदनात् च्युतम् |
प्रशशंस पुनर् मौर्ख्यात् भ्रातरम् रक्षसाम् वरम्
verses.iast:
sā prahṛṣṭvā vacaḥ śrutvā kharasya vadanāt cyutam |
praśaśaṃsa punar maurkhyāt bhrātaram rakṣasām varam
verses.translation: On hearing the words plunged from the mouth of Khara she is very much gladdened and in all her stupidity she further praised her brother highly saying, "you are the best among all the demons..."

glosses.meaning: she, frm Khara's, face - mouth, fallen

verses.devanagari:
तया परुषितः पूर्वम् पुनर् एव प्रशंसितः |
अब्रवीत् दूषणम् नाम खरः सेना पतिम् तदा
verses.iast:
tayā paruṣitaḥ pūrvam punar eva praśaṃsitaḥ |
abravīt dūṣaṇam nāma kharaḥ senā patim tadā
verses.translation: Though she denounced him earlier she alone praised him now for which Khara is overjoyed, and then he ordered his army commander, namely Duushana.

verses.devanagari:
चतुर्दश सहस्राणि मम चित्त अनुवर्तिनाम् |
रक्षसाम् भीम वेगानाम् समरेषु अनिवर्तिनाम्
verses.iast:
caturdaśa sahasrāṇi mama citta anuvartinām |
rakṣasām bhīma vegānām samareṣu anivartinām
verses.translation: "Those who are the followers of my will, whose hustle will be frightful and who will be unretreating in combats, such of those demons are there in fourteen thousand numbers, aren't they.

verses.devanagari:
नील जीमूत वर्णानाम् लोक हिंसा विहाराणाम् |
सर्व उद्योगम् उदीर्णानाम् रक्षसाम् सौम्य कारय
verses.iast:
nīla jīmūta varṇānām loka hiṃsā vihārāṇām |
sarva udyogam udīrṇānām rakṣasām saumya kāraya
verses.translation: "And oh, gentle Duushana, those domineering demons are with dark-clouds like complexions, and they are the pamperers of genocide, as such, cause them for a belligerency, all at once.
notes: The very sight of these black cloud like demons will be murderous to humans, as Rama exclaimed about Tataka. If the on looking humans are not dead at first sight of these demons, then these demons can pamper in killing humans

glosses.meaning: all at once, for activity - belligerence

verses.devanagari:
उपस्थापय मे क्षिप्रम् रथम् सौम्य धनूंषि च |
शरान् च चित्रान् खड्गां च शक्ती च विविधाः शिताः
verses.iast:
upasthāpaya me kṣipram ratham saumya dhanūṃṣi ca |
śarān ca citrān khaḍgāṃ ca śak{}tī ca vividhāḥ śitāḥ
verses.translation: "For me, oh, gentle one, promptly position my chariot before me along with bows and arrows, amazing swords and diverse sharp power bolts.

verses.devanagari:
अग्रे निर्यातुम् इच्छ्हामि पौलस्त्यानाम् महात्मनाम् |
वधार्थम् दुर्विनीतस्य रामस्य रण कोविद
verses.iast:
agre niryātum icchhāmi paulastyānām mahātmanām |
vadhārtham durvinītasya rāmasya raṇa kovida
verses.translation: "Oh, war pert Duushana, I wish to start ahead of all the demons of ours, who are the clans-demons of the great souled Paulastya, for the purpose of elimination of that evil-minded Rama." So said Khara to Duushana.
notes: For this Maheshvara Tiirtha says: rāmasya agre paulastyānām rākṣasānām vadhārtham niryātum iccāmi which gives meaning: "Before Rama I wish to present all the demonic clansmen of Sage Paulastya, for the purpose of elimination, for which I am starting ahead as a starter of this elimination process..."

verses.devanagari:
इति तस्य ब्रुवाणस्य सूर्य वर्णम् महारथम् |
सत् अश्वैः शबलैः युक्तम् आचचक्षे अथ दूषणः
verses.iast:
iti tasya bruvāṇasya sūrya varṇam mahāratham |
sat aśvaiḥ śabalaiḥ yuk{}tam ācacakṣe atha dūṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: While Khara is saying thus Duushana heralded saying, "Here comes the great chariot with sun's dazzle, yoked with very good horses of variegated colours."

verses.devanagari:
तम् मेरु शिखर आकारम् तप्त कांचन भूषणम् |
हेम चक्रम् असंबाधम् वैदूर्यमय कूबरम्
मत्स्यैः पुष्पैः द्रुमैः शैलैः चन्द्र सूर्यैः च कांचनैः |
मा.ंगल्यैः पक्षि सम्घैः च ताराभिः च समावृतम्
ध्वज निस्त्रिंश संपन्नम् किंकिणी वर भूषितम् |
सत् अश्व युक्तम् सः अमर्षात् आरुरोह खरः तदा
verses.iast:
tam meru śikhara ākāram tapta kāṃcana bhūṣaṇam |
hema cakram asambādham vaidūryamaya kūbaram
matsyaiḥ puṣpaiḥ drumaiḥ śailaiḥ candra sūryaiḥ ca kāṃcanaiḥ |
mā.ṃgalyaiḥ pakṣi samghaiḥ ca tārābhiḥ ca samāvṛtam
dhvaja nistriṃśa sampannam kiṃkiṇī vara bhūṣitam |
sat aśva yuk{}tam saḥ amarṣāt āruroha kharaḥ tadā
verses.translation: That chariot which has a roomy cabin with its rooftop like that of the ridge of Mt. Meru, body embellished in gold, wheels golden, gem-studded yoke-to-carriage shaft, all around encompassed with golden artefacts like fishes, flowers, trees, mountains, sun, moon, and auspicious birds flocks and stars, and even decorated with jingle-bells, endowed with flags, swords, and best horses, and such as it is, Khara embarked on it with all his rancour.

glosses.meaning: like Mt. Meru's, ridge, in shape
not, verily, inconvenient [not congested, having enough room, seating capacity]
with golden [with artefacts of gold, like]

verses.devanagari:
खरः तु तान् महत् सैन्याम् रथ चर्म आयुध ध्वजान् |
निर्यात इति अब्रवीत् प्रेक्ष्य दूषणः सर्व राक्षसान्
verses.iast:
kharaḥ tu tān mahat sainyām ratha carma āyudha dhvajān |
niryāta iti abravīt prekśya dūṣaṇaḥ sarva rākṣasān
verses.translation: On overseeing that great army with chariots, skins shields, weaponry and flags, and even at Duushana too, Khara charged all those demons saying "proceed."

glosses.meaning: which has - chariots, skins, [shields,] weaponry, flags

verses.devanagari:
ततः तद् राक्षसम् सैन्यम् घोर चर्म आयुध ध्वजम् |
निर्जगाम जन स्थानात् महानादम् महाजवम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ tad rākṣasam sainyam ghora carma āyudha dhvajam |
nirjagāma jana sthānāt mahānādam mahājavam
verses.translation: Then that demonic force with their ghoulish skin shields, weaponry and flags, issued forth from Janasthaana, blaring blatantly and foraying dashingly.

verses.devanagari:
मुद्गरैः पट्टिशैः शूलैः सुतीक्ष्णैः च परश्वधैः |
खड्गैः चक्रैः च हस्तस्थैः भ्राजमानैः स तोमरैः
शक्तिभिः परिघैः घोरैः अतिमात्रैः च कार्मुकैः |
गदा असि मुसलैः वज्रैः गृहीतैः भीम दर्शनैः
राक्षसानाम् सुघोराणाम् सहस्राणि चतुर्दश |
निर्यातानि जन स्थानात् खर चित्त अनुवर्तिनाम्
verses.iast:
mudgaraiḥ paṭṭiśaiḥ śūlaiḥ sutīkṣṇaiḥ ca paraśvadhaiḥ |
khaḍgaiḥ cakraiḥ ca hastasthaiḥ bhrājamānaiḥ sa tomaraiḥ
śak{}tibhiḥ parighaiḥ ghoraiḥ atimātraiḥ ca kārmukaiḥ |
gadā asi musalaiḥ vajraiḥ gṛhītaiḥ bhīma darśanaiḥ
rākṣasānām sughorāṇām sahasrāṇi caturdaśa |
niryātāni jana sthānāt khara citta anuvartinām
verses.translation: Wielding maces, dart-bolts, and spears, and also razor-sharp axes, swords and discs, and dreadful power-darts and power-bolts that are flashing, iron maces, unusual bows, clubs, scimitars and pounding-shafts, and even thunderbolt like weapons that are calamitous in look, that army which comprises fourteen thousand fiendish demons that are the followers of Khara's whim, has started from Janasthaana.
notes: Earlier batch which was sent against Rama consisted fourteen demons and now it is an army of fourteen thousand demons.

glosses.meaning: four, ten, thousand, [army of fourteen thousand]

verses.devanagari:
तान् तु निर्धावतो दृष्ट्वा राक्षसान् भीम दर्शनम् |
खरस्य अथ रथः किंचित् जगाम तत् अनन्तरम्
verses.iast:
tān tu nirdhāvato dṛṣṭvā rākṣasān bhīma darśanam |
kharasya atha rathaḥ kiñcit jagāma tat anantaram
verses.translation: On seeing the outrush of those demons of diabolic appearance, then Khara's chariot also proceeded a little later at their behind.

glosses.meaning: = a little, that, after - at their behind

verses.devanagari:
ततः तान् शबलान् अश्वान् तप्त कांचन भूषितान् |
खरस्य मतम् आज्ञाय सारथिः पर्यचोदयत्
verses.iast:
tataḥ tān śabalān aśvān tapta kāṃcana bhūṣitān |
kharasya matam ājñāya sārathiḥ paryacodayat
verses.translation: Then the charioteer set spurs on those colourful horses that are adorned in polished gold according to the notions of Khara.

glosses.meaning: set spurs to horses - speedily charioted.

verses.devanagari:
संचोदितो रथः शीघ्रम् खरस्य रिपु घातिनः |
शब्देन आपूरयामास दिशः स प्रदिशः तथा
verses.iast:
sañcodito rathaḥ śīghram kharasya ripu ghātinaḥ |
śabdena āpūrayāmāsa diśaḥ sa pradiśaḥ tathā
verses.translation: When the chariot of enemy destroyer Khara is driven that impetuously, it has started to swell earth's four cardinal quarters and inter-quarters with turbulence.

glosses.meaning: quarters, sa pra dishaH = with, inter, quarters

verses.devanagari:
प्रवृद्ध मन्युः तु खरः खर स्वरे
रिपोः वध अर्थम् त्वरितो यथा अंतकः |
अचूचुदत् सारथिम् उन्नदन् पुनर्
महाबलो मेघ इव अश्म वर्षवान्
verses.iast:
pravṛddha manyuḥ tu kharaḥ khara svare
ripoḥ vadha artham tvarito yathā aṃtakaḥ |
acūcudat sārathim unnadan punar
mahābalo megha iva aśma varṣavān
verses.translation: He whose voice is thunderous and whose rancour escalated speedily, and who is hastening forward like the Terminator intending to destroy his enemy, that Khara repeatedly hurried the charioteer shouting at him loudly like a overwhelming cloud that is going to storm stones.
